g.text: Powered by switched 5 V; independent of the MD62 heater rail.

g.desc: Powered by switched 5 V; independent of the MD62 heater rail.

g.text: C706 bypasses the LDO reference. Confirm stability with chosen capacitors.

g.desc: C706 bypasses the LDO reference. Confirm stability with chosen capacitors.

g.text: CO_LOGIC_3V0 powers the translator only; do not use a reserved module pin.

g.desc: CO_LOGIC_3V0 powers the translator only; do not use a reserved module pin.

g.text: ZE07-CO is CO, not CO2. Wired module with a separate boosted supply and 3.0 V UART translation.

g.desc: ZE07-CO is CO, not CO2. Wired module with a separate boosted supply and 3.0 V UART translation.

g.text: Join both ground pins at the module.

g.desc: Join both ground pins at the module.

g.text: 15-90% RH: dry gas may be out of range.

g.desc: 15-90% RH: dry gas may be out of range.

g.text: Invalid / stale data never means clean gas.

g.desc: Invalid / stale data never means clean gas.

g.text: A1 -> B1Y: host TX to module RX. B2 -> A2Y: module TX to host RX.

g.desc: A1 -> B1Y: host TX to module RX. B2 -> A2Y: module TX to host RX.

g.text: OE is low during reset. Enable only after the CO supply is valid;

g.desc: OE is low during reset. Enable only after the CO supply is valid;

g.text: disable OE before power-down. Firmware: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop.

g.desc: disable OE before power-down. Firmware: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop.

g.text: Verify >=5.0 V at the module under start-up and load; account for ripple and cable loss.
